lead: A layout rule `nvs fmt` learns is green only if the corpus already follows it.
body: `crates/nvs-fmt/tests/identity.rs` asserts every `.nvs` file under `examples/` and `tests/` comes back byte for byte, and that test is goal `fmt`'s stage-2 acceptance check, so it is a floor every later stage has to keep green. Before writing a rule into the printer, format the corpus with it and read what moves — a rule the corpus disagrees with lands *with* a corpus reformat or not at all.
